name: Skill Eval: browser-skills (issue #171)
description: Four-arm eval for browser-skills. Measures skill-vs-terse delta for browser automation tasks. Run with: sin-code eval run --dataset evals/skill-browser.json --arm baseline,terse,lazy_skill,skill-browser-tools

test_cases.prompt: Navigate to a web page, wait for it to load, and extract the title and all h1 headings. Return them as structured JSON.
test_cases.description: skill-browser-tools should use sin_scout to inspect the page structure and sin_execute to run the browser automation.

test_cases.prompt: Inspect a web page's DOM structure: count all form elements, list input fields with their types, and identify any broken links.
test_cases.description: skill-browser-tools should use sin_scout for DOM inspection and sin_execute for the browser query.
